name: AOD-9604
description: 16-amino-acid peptide from the tail of human growth hormone (177–191), plus one tyrosine

note.text: Six developer-funded trials in 893 people; the one paper on them reports safety only.

bullets: **Did not bind** the growth hormone receptor or make cells multiply (lab)
**Fat breakdown** rose and weight gain fell in obese mice and rats
**No rise in blood sugar** in animals, unlike whole growth hormone
**In people,** no mechanism has been shown to cause weight loss
The published paper reports safety only

practical.routes: By vein or by mouth in trials
practical.soldAs: No approved form; compounding nomination withdrawn

regulatory.text: Not in the Oct 2026 peptide policy

references: Stier, Vos and Kenley, AOD-9604 human trials, J Endocrinol Metab, Apr 2013
FDA, Bulk drug substances that may present significant safety risks, Apr 2026
